pages.title: The Inkwell Bookshop – Independent Books & Community
pages.html:
📚 The Inkwell

Welcome to The Inkwell Bookshop

Independent books and community in the heart of Portland

Featured Books

The Midnight Library

by Matt Haig

$17.99

A dazzling novel about all the choices that go into a life well lived, exploring the infinite possibilities of the roads not taken.

Lessons in Chemistry

by Bonnie Garmus

$18.50

A captivating story of an overlooked chemist in the 1960s who forms an unlikely friendship and pursues her dreams on live television.

The Four Winds

by Kristin Hannah

$19.99

An epic novel following a determined woman fighting to protect her family during the Great Depression and Dust Bowl era.

The House in the Cerulean Sea

by TJ Klune

$17.99

A heartwarming fantasy about a by-the-book caseworker who is sent to an orphanage for dangerous magical children.

Circe

by Madeline Miller

$18.99

A lyrical reimagining of the Greek goddess Circe, bringing her story from the margins of ancient mythology to vivid life.

Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow

by Gabrielle Zevin

$19.99

An intimate portrait of a lifelong friendship between two video game designers navigating ambition, love, and loss.

Opening Hours

  • Monday–Friday 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
  • Saturday 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
  • Sunday 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM
  • Public Holidays Closed

Visit Us

The Inkwell Bookshop

847 Maple Street
Portland, OR 97214

Phone: (503) 555-0142

Email: hello@inkwellbooks.local

About The Inkwell

Established in 2015, The Inkwell Bookshop has become a beloved destination for readers, thinkers, and curious minds throughout Portland. We are a proudly independent bookstore dedicated to curating thoughtfully chosen titles across all genres and age groups.

Our passion is connecting readers with stories that inspire, challenge, and transform. From bestselling fiction to hidden literary gems, from children's classics to specialized non-fiction, we believe every book has a reader waiting to discover it.

More than just a bookshop, The Inkwell is a community hub. We host regular author events, book clubs, writing workshops, and intimate gatherings for book lovers. Stop by and join our community today.

Get in Touch

Have a question or looking for a specific title? We'd love to hear from you. Visit us in person, call us, or send an email.
